chunks: He said: 'By Your authority, I will lead them astray, all of them.'
ai.seo_question: What did Iblis say to Allah regarding leading people astray?
ai.summary: In this verse, Iblis invokes Allah's majesty to swear his commitment to misguiding humanity, a declaration that Shia scholars interpret as a test of free will rather than absolute predestination. This vow establishes the cosmic struggle between good and evil, emphasizing that divine permission for Satan's influence serves to distinguish the sincere believers from the heedless. The context underscores the balance between divine decree (Qadr) and human agency, central to Shia theological discourse.
